Army of Two - PC port (recompilation of the Xbox 360 version)
=============================================================

This archive contains NO game files. You need your own copy of Army of Two
for Xbox 360 (European release) and Title Update 2.

REQUIREMENTS
- Windows 10/11 x64, a graphics card with DirectX 12.
- About 6 GB of disk space (plus 1.3 GB for the downloadable content).
- Extract the archive to an ordinary writable folder, for example
  C:\Games\ArmyOfTwo (not Program Files).

INSTALLATION
1. Start ArmyOfTwoLauncher.exe. If the game is not installed yet, the
   install screen opens.
2. "Game": choose the disc image (.iso), or default.xex in a folder with
   the already extracted game.
3. "Title Update 2": choose the update file
   TU_12K222C_0000004000000.00000000000G1 (on the console it is in
   Content\0000000000000000\4541084C\000B0000). It is required.
4. "Downloadable content (DLC)" is optional: the Veteran Map Pack and
   SSC Challenge: Versus Mode Pack 1 packages (on the console:
   Content\0000000000000000\454107F8\00000002). They can be added later:
   Settings -> Advanced -> Game files and DLC.
5. Press Install. The files are copied to the assets folder next to the
   game; the image is not needed afterwards. You can also simply drop the
   files on the launcher window.

During the first sessions the game compiles its shaders: expect short
stutters and objects missing for a moment. They do not come back.

UPDATING
Extract the new archive over the old one. The assets folder, your saves
(Documents\armyoftworecomp_tu2) and the launcher settings are kept.

CO-OP
Both players start the game from the launcher; both need the same version
of the port and the same downloadable content. See Settings -> Network in
the launcher.

CONTROLS
- Xbox gamepad: as on the console.
- Keyboard and mouse: WASD - move, mouse - camera, LMB - fire, RMB - aim,
  R - reload, Space - roll / cover, Ctrl/C - crouch, Esc - pause,
  E/Enter - use and select in menus, Backspace - back, Tab - GPS,
  Z - inventory, F - co-op commands, 1-4 - weapons / grenades,
  arrows - partner orders.
